research_title: Designing `mobile-app-hunter`: Deep Research for an Anthropic-Style Android and iOS Vulnerability-Hunting Skill
tool_attribution: The completed report states that Exa and Context7 were used; this integration reads that report and its citation metadata.

sources.title: MASVS coverage groups
sources.claim: Storage, cryptography, authentication/authorization, network, platform, code, resilience and privacy provide a coverage model.
sources.applicability: Map relevant product properties to categories; a category is neither a bounty policy nor a completed verification test.

sources.title: MASTG v2.0.0 release announcement
sources.claim: The research identifies the v2.0.0 release announcement dated 2026-07-04 and the separation of tests, techniques, demos, tools, knowledge and best practices.
sources.applicability: Use this named research baseline, not an evergreen latest claim. Pin an actual requirement/test revision before asserting conformance.

sources.title: Anthropic skill-creator
sources.claim: The research recommends concise triggering metadata, progressive resources, deterministic helpers and comparisons against a baseline.
sources.applicability: The cited main-branch URL is moving; no upstream commit was retained. These are design choices, not official certification.

sources.title: Android App Bundle
sources.claim: A publishing bundle can produce device-specific APK sets.
sources.applicability: Bind conclusions to the installed base/configuration/feature set, build variant and ABI; one supplied APK need not represent all deliveries.

sources.title: Android intent redirection
sources.claim: The report identifies Android 16 default hardening relevant to intent redirection.
sources.applicability: Establish device API, target SDK, selected path and applicable documented behavior. This source is neither a universal immunity claim nor a reason to disable protections.

sources.title: WebView native bridges
sources.claim: The report describes frame-origin limitations of addJavascriptInterface and distinct origin-validation concerns for message channels.
sources.applicability: Identify the actual API, frames, content and registration lifetime. Do not transfer one bridge API contract to another.

sources.title: Android Keystore
sources.claim: Keystore can keep key material non-exportable and constrain key use.
sources.applicability: Key exportability, user authentication, hardware support and business authorization are different properties; record the selected key attributes and environment.

sources.title: Android App Links verification
sources.claim: The research identifies link association and app selection as platform-specific evidence.
sources.applicability: Installed handler, domain association and OS behavior remain task-time facts; association alone does not authorize a resource.

sources.title: Play Integrity overview
sources.claim: Integrity signals contribute to server-side decisions.
sources.applicability: Do not substitute an integrity result for account/resource/action authorization or assume a universal device verdict.

sources.title: Apple app code signing
sources.claim: Apple app executable trust is based on code signing.
sources.applicability: Distinguish signed device app, extension, simulator, provisioning and source intent. Signing does not prove application correctness.

sources.title: Apple Keychain data protection
sources.claim: Keychain access and sharing depend on application identity, access groups and item protection policy.
sources.applicability: Use effective signed capabilities and item attributes; intended sharing among related apps is not by itself exposure.

sources.title: Apple Data Protection classes
sources.claim: Different protection classes intentionally have different accessibility across device-lock states.
sources.applicability: Record the actual class, relevant device state and intended availability. File Data Protection, Keychain attributes and local authentication are not interchangeable.

sources.title: Apple security overview
sources.claim: The research describes App Attest as an input to server integrity/risk decisions.
sources.applicability: This broad source does not verify a concrete App Attest API, payload format, request-binding implementation or device support matrix.

sources.title: Apple entitlements reference
sources.claim: The report retains this official API pointer but identifies JavaScript-rendered documentation limits.
sources.applicability: Detailed entitlement semantics still require accessible version-specific source documentation.

sources.title: Associated domain configuration
sources.claim: The report retains this official API pointer but identifies JavaScript-rendered documentation limits.
sources.applicability: Do not infer a detailed association-file grammar, cache behavior or OS-version contract from pointer presence.

sources.title: WKScriptMessageHandler
sources.claim: The report retains this official API pointer but identifies JavaScript-rendered documentation limits.
sources.applicability: Do not infer frame/origin or content-world API behavior from the Android bridge lesson.

sources.title: React Native security
sources.claim: The report says React Native provides no built-in sensitive-data store and describes Async Storage as unencrypted storage.
sources.applicability: Inspect the installed storage dependency and native adapters. Unencrypted does not mean publicly readable or sufficient proof of disclosure.

sources.title: Flutter platform channels
sources.claim: Platform channels cross between Dart and platform-native implementations; typing is not an authorization guarantee.
sources.applicability: Pin plugin/framework versions and selected Android/iOS implementations; do not presume platform parity from a shared API name.

sources.title: Microsoft EngageSDK disclosure
sources.claim: The report describes an SDK-added exported activity in the final merged manifest and associated delegated-authority consequences.
sources.applicability: Historical affected integration only. This teaching summary does not establish that a current app/version is affected or supply reproduction steps.

sources.title: Microsoft TikTok Android disclosure
sources.claim: The report describes security consequences from composition of link handling, WebView navigation and native JavaScript interfaces.
sources.applicability: Historical disclosure, not an assertion about current TikTok. Navigation and native capability must be evaluated together without generalizing every bridge to a defect.

sources.title: Home Assistant advisory lead
sources.claim: The research lists this advisory as a possible follow-up.
sources.applicability: Repository, affected component, conditions and fixed versions must be read before using this as a worked case.

sources.title: GitHub Security Lab Signal advisory lead
sources.claim: The research lists this advisory as a possible follow-up.
sources.applicability: A title or advisory identifier does not establish affected/fixed versions, prerequisites or a transferable case account.
